facts.business: Arrowhead Separation Engineering Limited provides technology-enabled process equipment solutions, including continuous drying and cooling systems, for the chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and food-processing sectors.
key_risks: Cost escalation and interest/finance-related outflows compressing margins
Early stage of new initiatives and transition toward higher value-add solutions
Dependence on policy tailwinds (National Manufacturing Mission, PLI-linked capex) and customer relationships in chemicals, pharmaceuticals, and food-processing sectors
